def: What it costs to complete one unit of work from end to end, including every model call, tool, retry and human step that touches it.
The cost per task divided by the share of tasks that end in an accepted result, so failures and rejected outputs are paid for.
A provider feature that bills a repeated, identical prompt prefix at a reduced rate when it is read again from a cache.
Everything the customer pays over the life of a system: building, running, supporting, changing it and the labour that works alongside it.
The share of time or effort a system frees that turns into something the customer can count, such as a hire not made or a backlog cleared.
Total benefit minus total cost, divided by total cost.
The sum of a project's yearly net benefits after discounting each by the customer's cost of capital, so later money counts for less.
The time until a project's cumulative net benefit turns positive.
Drawing many random combinations of uncertain inputs from stated ranges to see the spread of possible outcomes.
The value of one input at which a project's net present value is exactly zero, holding the others fixed.
